name: AK32F - Plug-In Formaldehyde Detector (HCHO, Temperature, Humidity), Electrochemical Sensor, Mains Powered
highlights: One Job, Done With the Right Sensor — An electrochemical cell reading formaldehyde and nothing else. No index to interpret, no other channels competing for the screen.
For the Months After a Fit-Out — New board, adhesive and upholstery release formaldehyde long after the smell fades. A permanently sited monitor is how anyone knows when it has actually stopped.
Temperature and Humidity for Context — Both drive the release rate, so both explain a change in the reading.
110–240 V, No Battery — Mains-powered, US or EU pins.
120 Per Carton — The simplest configuration in the range to stock and quote.
